scenes.headline: How a 4-bit KV cache fits in 56% of FP8
scenes.sub: SGLang's NVFP4 KV cache: one pool, a scale for every sixteen values.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Holly! SGLang can now keep its KV cache in four bits. Here's how.

scenes.text: Store each cached value in four bits, and give every block of sixteen its own 8-bit scale, so an outlier only spoils its own block.
scenes.say: Store each cached value in four bits, and give every sixteen values their own scale, so an outlier only spoils its block.

parts.note: an 8-bit E4M3 scale, shared by a block of B values
parts.say: Plus an eight-bit scale, shared by a block of B values.

parts.note: the published ratio: solve it, and B is 16
parts.say: Set it equal to point five six two five, and B comes out as exactly sixteen. The scale is already counted.

steps.say: Prefill computes in FP8, then packs keys and values into one pool: four-bit values, and a scale per sixteen.
Decode reads the four-bit cache directly. Fewer bytes per step: twenty-six to thirty percent more throughput at the same batch.
Chunked prefill expands the cached prefix back into FP8, so prefill gets no speedup.
Here is the post's own figure: one shared memory pool in the middle, and three attention paths around it.
Inside the pool: packed four-bit values, one block scale per sixteen elements, and a per-layer global scale.

left.title: 48 gated DeltaNet layers
left.say: The benchmarked model has sixty-four layers. Forty-eight are gated DeltaNet, holding a fixed-size state the flag never touches.

right.title: 16 full-attention layers
items: A cache that grows every token
right.say: Only the sixteen full-attention layers keep a per-token cache: thirty-two kibibytes a token in FP8, eighteen in four-bit.

scenes.title: Concurrent requests at 32K context
scenes.note: NVFP4 met the offered load, not its cache limit
scenes.say: At thirty-two K, FP8 fit forty-four requests, and four-bit fit seventy: every request the client offered. So the one point seven eight times went untested.

scenes.text: The 1.78x is a property of the cache pool, not the GPU: weights and workspace don't shrink.

recap: Decode reads 4-bit; prefill goes through FP8
scenes.say: To recap: four-bit values with a scale per sixteen, a faster decode, and a cache only full attention keeps.
